say:2:1510203001:1.text: We are your faithful followers, Herdmaster.
say:2:1510203001:1.source_cn: 雅库伯尔之月，兽群之主，伟大的狩猎神，我们都是您虔诚的信徒。
say:2:1510203001:1.male: We are your faithful followers, Herdmaster.
say:2:1510203001:1.female: We are your faithful followers, Herdmaster.

say:3:1510203002:1.text: Ask us any and all questions. We are forever loyal to you.
say:3:1510203002:1.source_cn: 请用最严苛的质询，来考验您子民的忠诚！
say:3:1510203002:1.male: Ask us any and all questions. We are forever loyal to you.
say:3:1510203002:1.female: Ask us any and all questions. We are forever loyal to you.

choice_prompt:4:1510203002.text: Ask us any and all questions. We are forever loyal to you.
choice_prompt:4:1510203002.source_cn: 请用最严苛的质询，来考验您子民的忠诚！
choice_prompt:4:1510203002.male: Ask us any and all questions. We are forever loyal to you.
choice_prompt:4:1510203002.female: Ask us any and all questions. We are forever loyal to you.

say:5:1510203003:1.text: Oh, it's a great honor to answer your questions, Herdmaster.
say:5:1510203003:1.source_cn: 喔……喔喔！竟然有幸能让狩猎神亲自过问……！
say:5:1510203003:1.male: Oh, it's a great honor to answer your questions, Herdmaster.
say:5:1510203003:1.female: Oh, it's a great honor to answer your questions, Herdmaster.

say:6:1510203004:1.text: I am Modra, High Priestess of the Wildborn and your most loyal servant.
say:6:1510203004:1.source_cn: 老朽是雅库伯尔部落巫祭，蒙多，是侍奉您的忠诚仆人。
say:6:1510203004:1.male: I am Modra, High Priestess of the Wildborn and your most loyal servant.
say:6:1510203004:1.female: I am Modra, High Priestess of the Wildborn and your most loyal servant.

say:7:1510203005:1.text: We were following the ancient rites and offering you pure flesh and soul under the Blood Moon, hoping for your blessing.
say:7:1510203005:1.source_cn: 我等刚才正依古训，在血月吉时为您献上纯洁的血肉与灵魂作...
say:7:1510203005:1.male: We were following the ancient rites and offering you pure flesh and soul under the Blood Moon, hoping for your blessing.
say:7:1510203005:1.female: We were following the ancient rites and offering you pure flesh and soul under the Blood Moon, hoping for your blessing.

say:8:1510203006:1.text: Not only did you answer our prayers, but came in person as well!
say:8:1510203006:1.source_cn: 不曾想，您不但回应了我等的祈求，甚至还以肉身亲临！
say:8:1510203006:1.male: Not only did you answer our prayers, but came in person as well!
say:8:1510203006:1.female: Not only did you answer our prayers, but came in person as well!

choice_prompt:9:1510203006.text: Not only did you answer our prayers, but came in person as well!
choice_prompt:9:1510203006.source_cn: 不曾想，您不但回应了我等的祈求，甚至还以肉身亲临！
choice_prompt:9:1510203006.male: Not only did you answer our prayers, but came in person as well!
choice_prompt:9:1510203006.female: Not only did you answer our prayers, but came in person as well!

say:10:1510203008:0.text: We all know that <style="highlight">the great Hunting God takes on many forms</style>.
say:10:1510203008:0.male: We all know that <style="highlight">the great Hunting God takes on many forms</style>.
say:10:1510203008:0.female: We all know that <style="highlight">the great Hunting God takes on many forms</style>.

say:11:1510203009:1.text: The ancient stories told of your first coming... a youthful man of unearthly grace. But when you returned a second time, you were a woman of fire and fury, impossible to ignore.
say:11:1510203009:1.source_cn: 古卷所记，第一次降临时，您是个俊美的少年；后来，您化身...
say:11:1510203009:1.male: The ancient stories told of your first coming... a youthful man of unearthly grace. But when you returned a second time, you were a woman of fire and fury, impossible to ignore.
say:11:1510203009:1.female: The ancient stories told of your first coming... a youthful man of unearthly grace. But when you returned a second time, you were a woman of fire and fury, impossible to ignore.

say:12:1510203010:1.text: But this time, your chosen form is indeed surprising. Who would've thought you'd take the shape of a Halian, our sworn enemy...
say:12:1510203010:1.source_cn: 不过您这次选择的面容确实令人意外……没想到您竟会化身为...
say:12:1510203010:1.male: But this time, your chosen form is indeed surprising. Who would've thought you'd take the shape of a Halian, our sworn enemy...
say:12:1510203010:1.female: But this time, your chosen form is indeed surprising. Who would've thought you'd take the shape of a Halian, our sworn enemy...

say:13:1510203011:1.text: Those clawless apes have invaded our territory, defying us with their relentless incursions!
say:13:1510203011:1.source_cn: 呼临那些无爪无牙的人类渣滓，屡屡侵犯我们的领地！
say:13:1510203011:1.male: Those clawless apes have invaded our territory, defying us with their relentless incursions!
say:13:1510203011:1.female: Those clawless apes have invaded our territory, defying us with their relentless incursions!

say:14:1510203012:1.text: For this reason, we called upon you, Herdmaster, to help us vanquish our invaders in one fell swoop.
say:14:1510203012:1.source_cn: 所以我们才要借助神明的伟力，一举击溃那些入侵者！
say:14:1510203012:1.male: For this reason, we called upon you, Herdmaster, to help us vanquish our invaders in one fell swoop.
say:14:1510203012:1.female: For this reason, we called upon you, Herdmaster, to help us vanquish our invaders in one fell swoop.

choice_prompt:15:1510203012.text: For this reason, we called upon you, Herdmaster, to help us vanquish our invaders in one fell swoop.
choice_prompt:15:1510203012.source_cn: 所以我们才要借助神明的伟力，一举击溃那些入侵者！
choice_prompt:15:1510203012.male: For this reason, we called upon you, Herdmaster, to help us vanquish our invaders in one fell swoop.
choice_prompt:15:1510203012.female: For this reason, we called upon you, Herdmaster, to help us vanquish our invaders in one fell swoop.

say:16:1510203013:1.text: Clan? We have no clans. There has only ever been the Wildborn and our enemies!
say:16:1510203013:1.source_cn: 哪个？只有一个雅库伯尔，没有其他部落！
say:16:1510203013:1.male: Clan? We have no clans. There has only ever been the Wildborn and our enemies!
say:16:1510203013:1.female: Clan? We have no clans. There has only ever been the Wildborn and our enemies!

say:17:1510203014:1.text: But this word "Mauler"... It sounds fierce and brave. Is this the name you will give us?
say:17:1510203014:1.source_cn: 但蛮血是个很好的名字，威风勇武，这是您给我们的赐名吗？
say:17:1510203014:1.male: But this word "Mauler"... It sounds fierce and brave. Is this the name you will give us?
say:17:1510203014:1.female: But this word "Mauler"... It sounds fierce and brave. Is this the name you will give us?

choice_prompt:18:1510203014.text: But this word "Mauler"... It sounds fierce and brave. Is this the name you will give us?
choice_prompt:18:1510203014.source_cn: 但蛮血是个很好的名字，威风勇武，这是您给我们的赐名吗？
choice_prompt:18:1510203014.male: But this word "Mauler"... It sounds fierce and brave. Is this the name you will give us?
choice_prompt:18:1510203014.female: But this word "Mauler"... It sounds fierce and brave. Is this the name you will give us?

say:19:1510203016:1.text: I don't know what you mean, Herdmaster. Please accept our humble offering and sacrifice as a token of our unwavering devotion and submission.
say:19:1510203016:1.source_cn: 请、请息怒！请纳受我们向您奉上的祭品吧，那足以证明我们...
say:19:1510203016:1.male: I don't know what you mean, Herdmaster. Please accept our humble offering and sacrifice as a token of our unwavering devotion and submission.
say:19:1510203016:1.female: I don't know what you mean, Herdmaster. Please accept our humble offering and sacrifice as a token of our unwavering devotion and submission.

choice_prompt:20:1510203016.text: I don't know what you mean, Herdmaster. Please accept our humble offering and sacrifice as a token of our unwavering devotion and submission.
choice_prompt:20:1510203016.source_cn: 请、请息怒！请纳受我们向您奉上的祭品吧，那足以证明我们的卑微与虔敬！
choice_prompt:20:1510203016.male: I don't know what you mean, Herdmaster. Please accept our humble offering and sacrifice as a token of our unwavering devotion and submission.
choice_prompt:20:1510203016.female: I don't know what you mean, Herdmaster. Please accept our humble offering and sacrifice as a token of our unwavering devotion and submission.

say:21:1510203017:1.text: We've carefully selected a pure soul in your honor. She awaits you.
say:21:1510203017:1.source_cn: 是我们千挑万选出的纯洁灵魂——她正在等待着您！
say:21:1510203017:1.male: We've carefully selected a pure soul in your honor. She awaits you.
say:21:1510203017:1.female: We've carefully selected a pure soul in your honor. She awaits you.

choice:20:0:1.text: What do you mean offering and sacrifice?
choice:20:0:1.male: What do you mean offering and sacrifice?
choice:20:0:1.female: What do you mean offering and sacrifice?

choice:15:0:1.text: Which Mauler clan are you all from?
choice:15:0:1.source_cn: 你们是哪个蛮血部落的？
choice:15:0:1.male: Which Mauler clan are you all from?
choice:15:0:1.female: Which Mauler clan are you all from?

say:23:1510203015:1.text: No, never... Would you like us to build you a new temple?
say:23:1510203015:1.source_cn: 从未……部落中的巫祭只有老朽数人，而您的神殿坐落于更远...
say:23:1510203015:1.male: No, never... Would you like us to build you a new temple?
say:23:1510203015:1.female: No, never... Would you like us to build you a new temple?

choice_prompt:24:1510203015.text: No, never... Would you like us to build you a new temple?
choice_prompt:24:1510203015.source_cn: 从未……部落中的巫祭只有老朽数人，而您的神殿坐落于更远的地方。您需要我们再兴建一座新的神殿吗？
choice_prompt:24:1510203015.male: No, never... Would you like us to build you a new temple?
choice_prompt:24:1510203015.female: No, never... Would you like us to build you a new temple?

choice:15:1:2.text: Have you heard of the Sandscript Temple?
choice:15:1:2.source_cn: 听说过沙之书、神庙或者大祭司吗？
choice:15:1:2.male: Have you heard of the Sandscript Temple?
choice:15:1:2.female: Have you heard of the Sandscript Temple?

choice:9:0:1.text: Do I look like your god?
choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 我长得很像你们的神吗？
choice:9:0:1.male: Do I look like your god?
choice:9:0:1.female: Do I look like your goddess?

say:25:1510203007:0.text: Of course, you are a god among mortals! How could we compare to you?!
say:25:1510203007:0.source_cn: 当然不一样，您是降临于世的神明本尊，岂能与我们这些凡人...
say:25:1510203007:0.male: Of course, you are a god among mortals! How could we compare to you?!
say:25:1510203007:0.female: Of course, you are a goddess among mortals! How could we compare to you?!

choice:9:1:2.text: But I look different from you all...
choice:9:1:2.source_cn: 你不觉得我和你们……不一样？
choice:9:1:2.male: But I look different from you all...
choice:9:1:2.female: But I look different from you all...
